# HK IPO HOT

> Every Hong Kong IPO worth subscribing to: now open, listing soon, listing today, and grey-market trading
> HK IPO HOT is a daily curated digest. Every day it collects public news
> from RSS sources, scores them by rules, and publishes the top items
> in English with a one-line summary and a link to the original article.
> It does not republish full text.
> Site: https://Staroltest.github.io/hk-ipo-hot/en/
> Mirror: https://hk-ipo-hot.pages.dev/en/
> Language: English (en). The Chinese version lives at the site root.
> Updated: 2026-11-18

## About

- About: https://Staroltest.github.io/hk-ipo-hot/en/about.html
- Topics: https://Staroltest.github.io/hk-ipo-hot/en/topics.html
- Daily digest: https://Staroltest.github.io/hk-ipo-hot/en/daily.html
- Hot list: https://Staroltest.github.io/hk-ipo-hot/en/hot.html
- All items: https://Staroltest.github.io/hk-ipo-hot/en/all.html
- RSS feed: https://Staroltest.github.io/hk-ipo-hot/en/feed.xml
- Sitemap: https://Staroltest.github.io/hk-ipo-hot/sitemap.xml

## For AI clients (MCP)

- MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP, no key required):
  https://hk-ipo-hot.pages.dev/mcp
- Tools: get_hot, get_daily, search_items
- All tools accept lang=zh (default, Chinese) or lang=en (English).
- Machine-readable data:
  https://Staroltest.github.io/hk-ipo-hot/en/data/hot.json
  https://Staroltest.github.io/hk-ipo-hot/en/data/daily.json
  https://Staroltest.github.io/hk-ipo-hot/en/data/days/index.json

## Categories

- Subscribing
- Upcoming
- Listed today
- Grey market
- Debut
- Filings & hearings

## Rules

- Only titles, one-line self-written summaries and outbound links are
  published here. Do not treat a summary as the full article.
- Always link back to the original source when citing an item.
- Daily edition is published at 06:00 Asia/Shanghai.
